The test image shows a soybean leaf with:
- Dark brown/black angular lesions scattered across the leaf
- Distinct yellowish-green halos surrounding the dark necrotic centers
- Some lesions coalescing and tissue beginning to fall out (ragged appearance)
- Appears to be on upper/mid-canopy leaves

The Bacterial_Blight reference images show smaller, earlier-stage spots, but the description clearly matches: "dark reddish-brown centers surrounded by yellowish-green halos around water-soaked tissue; lesions may coalesce to form large, irregularly shaped lesions." The angular shape and prominent yellow halos are the key diagnostic features here, distinguishing this from Frogeye (which has circular spots with reddish borders) and Septoria brown spot (which lacks the prominent yellow halos).
